description: Lists supported industries with canonical IDs/slugs, names, descriptions and aliases. Includes cross-industry, consumer and agent audiences when available. An optional query filters this directory; without it the directory is browsable with pagination.

limit.description: Requested number of individual result rows (1–50): top 2 corresponds to limit 2. Also the page size for continuation requests.

offset.description: Row offset. Use nextOffset from the previous response.
